newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo industry dismisses 10,528 in March.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo industry dismisses 10,528 in March.

text.p: Private companies in the Brazilian state of Sao Paulo dismissed 10,528 industrial workers in March, up from 6,990 dismissed in February, Sao Paulo State Industries Federation (Fiesp) said on Monday.
Fiesp said in a statement that 3,191 workers lost their jobs in the last week of March alone.
The March result takes the year-to-date number of layoffs in the industrial sector to 26,015. Fiesp said 116,646 industrial workers have lost their jobs in Sao Paulo in the last 12 months.
Candy, clothing and paper product producers showed the most layoffs. Sectors that reported some jobs growth included electrical energy and footwear.
